deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open. Bachelor's holders applying for the Direct Doctorate must apply in the Master's window, 1-30 November 2026.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

also.quote: International Bachelor's degrees: 1 - 30 November 2026 | students who wish to apply for the Excellence & Opportunity Scholarship Programme (ESOP) or a Direct doctorate programme (DD)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: For the regular doctorate you must find an ETH professor who offers you a position (contact research groups directly). Direct Doctorate students choose their supervisor later.
supervisor.quote: In order to be able to complete a doctorate at ETH, a professor at ETH must be willing to supervise your dissertation.

also.quote: the Doctoral Study Program offers the opportunity to directly join one of our internationally renowned research groups

funding.value: Doctoral students are paid a competitive salary; Direct Doctorate students get a full scholarship and tuition waiver for the first two years, then a salary.
funding.quote: The rewarding work experience is complemented by a competitive salary that comfortably covers the living expenses in Switzerland.

also.quote: Students in this programme are entitled to financial support and tuition waivers in the form of a full scholarship during the first two study years and, thereafter, to a competitive salary that covers living expenses in Switzerland.

entry_route.value: The Doctoral Study Programme is for Master's holders; Bachelor's graduates can apply for the Direct Doctorate in Computer Science (5-6 years) through the Master's application tool.
entry_route.quote: To students holding a Master's degree with a strong background in computer science or a closely related field, the Doctoral Study Program offers | Students with a Bachelor's degree in computer science or a closely related field with a strong interest in research have the chance to directly enroll as a doctoral student through the Direct Doctorate in Computer Science.

also.quote: Direct Doctorate applicants use the same application tool as master's applicants.

notes: Admission is highly competitive (few openings). Direct Doctorate applications go through the MSc Computer Science application (C1 English proof required for that route) in the November window.
